questions.question: Where was this covenant made, besides the one at Horeb?
What did Moses say about "the secret things"?
options: They will be uncovered on the day of the LORD
They are made known only to the priests and Levites
They are written in a sealed and hidden book
They belong to God; revealed things belong to Israel
questions.answer: They belong to God; revealed things belong to Israel

questions.question: The covenant was made not only with those present but with future generations.
